comments.text:
Sketch complete. Three-layer architecture:

1. GenTailscale.Transport (behaviour, 77 lines) — abstract I/O contract
2. GenTailscale.Transport.TsElixir (60 lines) — delegates to ts_elixir NIFs  
3. GenTailscale.Transport.Simulator (472 lines) — deterministic sim with:
   - Seeded PRNG for all randomness
   - In-memory connection buffers (bidirectional)
   - Fault injection: partial reads, send failures, connection drops
   - Accept parking (callers block until simulate_client_connect)
   - Event log for debugging
   - Test helpers: inject_data, simulate_client_connect, event_log

Socket and Listener updated to take transport as first arg, never call NIFs directly.
All files in gen_tailscale repo (separate from tailscale_transport).

Updated:
- Simulator moved to test/support/simulator.ex (not in lib/)
- recv now parks callers when buffer empty, unparks on inject_data
- accept already parked, unchanged
- Renamed buffer fields for clarity: server_recv_buf (what server reads), client_recv_buf (what server writes)
- Added do_close_stream helper that unparks waiting recv callers with {:error, :closed}
- Added unpark_all_with_error for clean teardown of parked callers on close
- Added read_server_sent/2 test helper to inspect what server has sent
- Added inject_data logging and recv_parked/recv_unparked events

title: Design Transport behaviour and deterministic simulator
